name: UniBotRouter
fix_description: Function 0xb2bd16ab performs an external call to a user-supplied target address without validating it against a whitelist. Attacker passes a token contract address with transferFrom calldata to steal tokens approved to this router. Fix: validate that the call target is a whitelisted swap router/protocol.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is more than a trivial single-call bug: it uses a flash loan, interacts with a specific AMM pair, and relies on understanding how repeated token transfers plus skim() can manipulate pool balances before swapping back. While the PoC is short, the vulnerability is protocol-specific and requires DeFi/Uniswap reserve-accounting knowledge, placing it above easy but below a deeply complex multi-contract attack.
